ModMetaData.name: No Steam Popup
ModMetaData.author: CryptikLemur
ModMetaData.description:
Drops the "Could not initialize Steam API" dialog that RimWorld shows on the main menu when no Steam client is reachable.
Built for gamecrate containers, where there is never a Steam client and the dialog is only ever in the way. Nothing else about Steam changes: workshop, stats and the overlay stay exactly as broken or working as they were.
